title: Texas College Station Taiwan Study Club 德州卡城台灣研究社
content_html: The Texas College Station Taiwan Study Club is a student organization based in College Station, Texas, focused on the study of Taiwanese history, culture, politics, economics, and society. The club promotes Taiwanese identity and consciousness, and advocates for Taiwan’s democracy and human rights. Members gather regularly for study sessions and discussions to understand Taiwan’s past, present, and future. The club was founded by Professor 黃界清 and a group of founding members, and has maintained an active leadership structure since its inception.
